name: Bali Tourism Board
description: Official Bali Tourism Board — visa information, district travel advisories, event calendar (Nyepi, Galungan, Kuningan), recommended guides, and Bali Safe tourist helpline.

name: Bali Zoo
description: Bali's leading wildlife park in Singapadu — Komodo dragons, Sumatran tigers, orangutans, and 500+ species. Night safari and breakfast with orangutans.

name: Tanah Lot Temple
description: Bali's most iconic sea temple on a sea-stack in Tabanan. Sunset viewing, sarong rental, and tide-dependent causeway walk.

name: BTDC Nusa Dua
description: Nusa Dua's integrated luxury beach resort complex — home to St. Regis, Mulia, and Conrad hotels. Beach club access and convention centre bookings.

name: Ngurah Rai Airport
description: Bali's international airport — flight information, lost & found, taxi dispatch, car rental desks, and Sky Bridge to the international terminal.

name: Kuta Tourist Police
description: English-speaking tourist police covering Kuta, Seminyak, and Legian. For theft reports, lost passports, beach safety incidents, and non-emergency tourist assistance.

name: Bali Hai Cruises
description: Bali's largest cruise operator — day trips to Nusa Lembongan, Amed dive days, and private charter boats from Benoa Harbour.

name: Pura Besakih
description: Bali's holiest temple complex on Mt. Agung — 23 temples across 3km of terraced hillside. Sarong mandatory. Restricted during major Balinese ceremonies.
